mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sellers(sel_id, sel_pw, sel_nm, adm_id, sel_rn, sel_mn, sel_cs, sel_br, sel_ad, sel_bf, sel_st, sel_at )VALUES (#{storeId}, #{storePw}, #{storeNm}, 'admin', #{ceoNm}, #{phNm}, #{storeNumber}, #{brn}, #{storead}, #{sel_bf}, 'ss01', DEFAULT)
mapper.select: SELECT p.prd_nm, p.prd_ct, p.prd_cd, p.prd_op, p.prd_sp, p.prd_ca, p.prd_sf, p.prd_bd FROM products p WHERE p.prd_cd = #{prd_cd}
SELECT o.clr_cd, o.clr_nm, o.prd_qt, cd.cod_nm FROM options o JOIN common_detailcode cd ON o.siz_nm = cd.cod_cd WHERE prd_cd = #{prd_cd}
SELECT fil_nm, fil_pt FROM product_images WHERE prd_cd = #{prd_cd}

SELECT pd.prd_cd, pd.prd_nm, cd.cod_nm, ot.clr_nm, odd.odd_qt, bu.buy_em, bu.buy_nm, bu.buy_ph, od.ord_ad, od.ord_dm, od.ord_nm, od.ord_ph, odd.odd_am, od.ord_pm FROM products pd JOIN options ot ON pd.prd_cd = ot.prd_cd JOIN order_details odd ON ot.opt_id = odd.opt_id JOIN orders od ON odd.ord_id = od.ord_id JOIN buyers bu ON od.buy_em = bu.buy_em JOIN common_detailcode cd ON ot.siz_nm = cd.cod_cd WHERE od.ord_id = #{ord_id}
